# Periodic Service Health Probe with Alerting

## Overview
Continuously monitors a critical service and pages on-call only when it reports unhealthy, keeping alert noise low.

## Prerequisites
Requires the PD_TOKEN secret for PagerDuty, and reaches api.internal.example.com and hooks.pagerduty.com.

## Trigger
Cron Trigger — fires every 5 minutes (cron `*/5 * * * *`).

## Walkthrough
1. Every 5 Minutes (Cron Trigger) starts the run on schedule.
2. Probe Health (HTTP Request) GETs the internal `/health` endpoint with a 3000 ms timeout.
3. Unhealthy? (Conditional) checks whether the probed status is not "ok".
4. On true, Page On-Call (HTTP Request) POSTs a critical incident to PagerDuty using the PD_TOKEN secret.

## Data Flow
Probe Health's `status` field drives the condition; no data flows on the healthy path.

## Decisions
Unhealthy?: when `{{steps.probe.body.status}} != "ok"` the run takes the true path to Page On-Call; otherwise it ends.

## Error Handling
None configured: a probe timeout counts as unhealthy and pages; a PagerDuty failure means the incident is not created.
